en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_desc: Heiress Marchetti leads a strike team against Aurelian Holdings after they suddenly attacked a Ferrovald Syndicate outpost. No time to waste waiting for Foundermaster Ferron to send orders.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t1: Sir! I'm bearing important frontline report.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t2: What is the situation? Have we taken the outpost?
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t3: We did, Sir! The second battalion caught them by surprise, they seemed unprepared.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t5: Not quite... Aurelian Holdings soldiers put up a real fight, we have lost more units than anticipated. Our scouts have seen Heir Corvin evacuating from the base not long after our initial strike.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t6: Heir Corvin running away with his tail between his legs? Not surprising. It would explain why they fought so ferociously. Are our forces ready for another push?
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t7: I'm afraid not. They have a lot of wounded soldiers and damaged equipment, which slows them down significantly. The second battalion will not be able to assist for a couple of days.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t8: Bah! I'll reprimand their commander once we join forces. You are dismissed.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t10: Without the second battalion this attack might be difficult.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t11: I only have a few units here. It will have to do.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t12: There are some old Infantry barracks here, I could use them.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t13: I have to capture that outpost to secure this mountain passage into Aurelian Holdings lands.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t14: There is a Tank guarding it though. These are very effective against Infantry, I have to be careful. It does not look like they can deploy more of them though. If I take it out, my mission will be much easier.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t15: Luckily, I do have a couple of aces up my sleeve.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t16: That Infantry unit can now use their Heavy Weapon ability, which should make a quick job of that Tank. It does require that unit to get close and has a long cooldown, so I have to be careful. Leveling up other Infantry units is a good idea.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t17: In order to make sure my Infantry units survive combat with that Tank, I can use my active ability - Hardened Armour. When used, it increases the armour of all units standing 2 tiles away from me, or closer. To use it, I have to cast it on myself.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t19: Enemy command has been captured, Sir!
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t21: I see you were not wasting any time, Marchetti.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t22: Lord's lapdog himself showed up. I'm busy, Brandt.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t23: Not anymore. Foundermaster Ferron sent me to bring new orders to you, personally. Aurelian Holdings's attack concerns him, but he wants to get in touch with Chairman Aurelian first, to explain matters. You will take your forces and retreat to Ferrovald Syndicate lands at once.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t24: And let them get away with an attack against us? Just like that?
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t27: Splendid. I'll return to Ferronhold to attend to other matters.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t28: Foundermaster Ferron is getting soft. Our lands are being attacked and all he can do is sit and wait.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t29: Ferrovald Syndicate deserves better. Aurelian Holdings will pay for their boldness, and when I return, other nobles will surely see which one of us would be a better ruler.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_desc: After meeting up with the Second Battalion, Marchetti plans his next move. He needs to secure supply lines before venturing deeper into Aurelian Holdings territory.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_t1: This is taking too long! Where are my troops?
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_t2: They are on their way, Sir, but we are having trouble supplying them with fuel.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_t3: We need a better route then.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_t4: If we could secure this highway, we could bring in more supplies quickly. It's not going to be easy though.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_t5: Aurelian Holdings has guarded Barracks right in our path.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_t6: Another Barracks and an industrial Factory on the other side of town have to be taken care of as well.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_t7: We are going to need some Tanks then.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_t8: Second Battalion veterans are at your command. They can use Long-range Shell ability, allowing them to hit targets up to one tile away in a straight line. They can take out an enemy Tank before it is able to retaliate.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_t9: We have almost finished setting up our own Tank factory. All it needs is a crew.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_t10: Marvelous. My passive ability allows me to build Tanks using less AP than usual. That should give me an edge over Aurelian Holdings.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_t11: Mission complete, Sir! With this route secured, we will be able to advance much faster.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_t12: Get moving then. We are already late with the next phase.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m3_desc: Faced with ever-increasing amounts of Aurelian Holdings armored vehicles, the first Battalion under Marchetti's command needs to establish air superiority.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m3_t1: What does the road ahead look like?
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m3_t2: Aurelian Holdings has a lot of Factories here, Sir.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m3_t3: There is one nearby, with some tanks ready to go.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m3_t4: Their main forces are stationed in a nearby town.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m3_t5: They have several Towers in the area for support, so we should expect a lot of Tanks to be produced.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m3_t6: We need to hasten our work on the Airfield then.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m3_t7: It is still being worked on, it will take some time for it to provide air support.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m3_t8: These veteran units will help in stopping Aurelian Holdings for now, but we can't hold this position for long.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m3_o1: Defend until your Airfield becomes available.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m3_t10: Air support is ready to go. Those Tanks are going to be helpless against them!
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m3_t11: Town guards have been defeated. With an Airfield in this area, Ferrovald Syndicate can bring in all the units that we need to beat Aurelian Holdings once and for all.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_desc: Assembled forces of Ferrovald Syndicate face one last obstacle on their way to Aurelian Bastion: the Aurelian River.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t1: We've got the upper hand in this fight now.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t2: Our base is nearly done, Sir. A couple of buildings still need a crew.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t3: What is the situation at the river crossing?
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t4: Take a look at this intel, Sir.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t5: The bridge is heavily guarded by armour and infantry.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t6: It is supplied by a small checkpoint nearby.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t7: The other side is guarded as well.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t8: A much larger installation is present there as well.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t9: That HQ building must be coordinating all of their forces. Taking it is our main objective.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t11: On its way, should be here very soon.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t12: Good. Start building up our army in the meantime, then attack that checkpoint.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t13: Air support is in the area. Waiting for orders.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t14: A veteran Attack Helicopter will be very useful.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t15: Our tower has been monitoring this flank.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t16: It appears there are no enemy units on this side. The way to the enemy HQ is wide open.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t17: The only problem is the river. It is very wide and deep. This is where that helicopter comes in.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t18: An Attack Helicopter is capable of carrying a single Infantry unit on board. If we can ferry a few units, we can perform a back attack.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t19: Make sure that they have cover, as these Infantry units will not be able to do anything until their next turn, right after deployment.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t20: We can also use our helicopters to perform flanking attacks on enemy units trying to hold or cross the bridge. Any Tank will be a sitting duck.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_o1: (Optional) Transport Infantry units for the back attack.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t21: Without their command center, enemy forces will disperse. Let's secure this base and start bringing our Tanks over the bridge for the final assault.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_desc: Ferrovald Syndicate is pushing forward with their offensive. Marchetti prepares to capture a strategic position, that will allow him to lay a siege on the Aurelian Holdings capital city of Aurelian Bastion.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t1: I need to get to the Aurelian Bastion to see my father right now!
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t2: I'm sorry my heir, but getting into the city might be very difficult. Ferrovald Syndicate is approaching fast.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t3: No one has seen Chairman Aurelian since the invasion started. Commander Vex is relaying orders from him.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t4: My father hiding? He would never do such a thing!
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t5: Ferrovald Syndicate's main army was spotted!
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t6: To arms! We have to stop them!
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t8: Aurelian Holdings's capital city is in our sight.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t9: That base is in a perfect spot, if we take it, we can easily occupy the city from there.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t10: We have some trouble, Sir. Our forward outposts have been spotted early.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t11: Infantry barracks are here. This should be our top priority, Aurelian Holdings can use them to attack our flank.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t12: Factory here has no crew but is guarded by a Tank, we should be careful.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t13: We managed to deploy an Airfield further out, with some Towers for support.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t14: Failure is not an option at this point. I can already smell victory.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t15: Position taken. Start preparing troop transports to cross the water.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t16: Hahaha, that was easier than I expected. Aurelian Bastion will be ours soon, and then we will see what can be done about Foundermaster Ferron...
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t18: Brandt? What are you doing here?
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t19: You have disobeyed the Lord's orders. Your offensive ends here. Men, arrest him.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t20: Don't you dare to lay your hands on me!
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t21: I will deliver you to Ferronhold personally.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t22: Argh! This is no good! I can't keep it up.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t23: I must find my father immediately.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t24: Haha! The cowardly heir flees yet again.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_desc: Brandt's task is simple: bring Heiress Marchetti back to Ferronhold. Or so it seemed, as a new and unexpected force is standing in his way, cutting him off.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t1: Marchetti made such a mess! It's unbelievable! And now I will have to endure his company all the way to Ferronhold. *sigh*
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t2: It can't be helped. Soldier! Go tell the guards to bring him in and we will depart.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t3: Sir! Sir! I have important news!
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t4: What is it? Catch your breath and tell me.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t5: It's Meridian Combine! They are everywhere! Have a look!
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t6: They are already setting up blockades.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t7: But that is not all! We've got an emergency transmission from Foundermaster Ferron. Meridian Combine is already assaulting our border. You are being ordered to return as quickly as possible and organize defense.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t8: What are we waiting for then? Organize Marchetti's forces and go home!
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t9: I don't think we can, Sir.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t10: Meridian Combine gathered huge forces on the other side of the river. They are ready to strike on our positions. If we try to move now, they will surely take advantage and wipe us out.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t11: This is really bad. Looks like our best chance is to sneak past them with a small detachment. Heiress Marchetti will have to stay here for a little longer...
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t12: My goal is to reach that road. Looks like Meridian Combine is using some of the Aurelian Holdings towers to supply themselves.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t13: We have barracks and a single tower here. Our resources are going to be really stretched, but it will have to do.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t14: My passive ability allows me to get an additional 5AP from every tower, each turn. It is not much, but it stacks up.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t16: You have nowhere to run. Surrender now!
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t17: I'm afraid that is out of the question. We have to deal with that Tank somehow. I can deal significant damage to it, but constant fighting might wear me down, so I have to be careful.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t18: I have to move, there is no time to lose.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_o1: Bring Consigliere Brandt to the end of the road.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t19: Mobile Infantry is ready to support you, Sir.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t20: This is exactly what I needed. These motorized units are much faster than regular Infantry. They are ideal for quick capture jobs. Their weaponry is not as good, so they can't attack flying targets, though it seems it will not be an issue at this time.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t21: We also have some experience, Sir, so we can use our abilities to heal soldiers and even repair vehicles. It costs AP though. We will do what we can to keep you in this fight!
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t22: I can recruit more Mobile Infantry units in the barracks if need be.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t23: What is Meridian Combine doing here? And attacking our lands as well? Has Aurelian Holdings asked them for help? Or are they just using an opportunity?
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t24: No matter. I am needed at our border.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t25: I have failed you, my lord! Please forgive me!
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_desc: Ferrovald Syndicate lands are under attack. Consigliere Brandt must secure the base in Tripoint and stop Meridian Combine before it is too late.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t1: Oh no, our base is already lost. And now they are using our equipment.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t2: I need these facilities if I am to stop them from sending in more troops toward Ferronhold. HQ building is my top priority - if I capture it, I can re-take control of the entire base.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t3: They have a sizable garrison, I need to be careful.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t4: Good thing I've got two Scout Helicopters at my disposal. They have less firepower than the Attack variety, but they are faster.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t5: Do we have any intel on the area?
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t6: Mobile Brigade garrison is nearby, but it has been captured. If we claim it, we will have access to more Mobile Infantry units, as our current Barracks can't deploy them.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t8: It does not appear to be operational. We have deployed a paratrooper unit there, but...
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t9: Meridian Combine sent a Tank on patrol, and it is very close. Unless we do something, that Infantry unit is lost.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t10: I'm an experienced pilot, and I know this nimble machine very well. I can use my active ability to fully replenish my MP, and even perform another attack on the same turn. I do need 1MP to activate it though, so make sure to not order me to use it all up if you intend me to use Rapid Response.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t11: I should be able to get there in time and keep Tanks at bay until our boys capture the building.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t12: Do what you can, we need those flying units.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t13: Thank you for the air support, we couldn't have done this without you!
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t15: Sorry for the delay, Sir. We took the long route. Ready to support the southern flank.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t16: Great work men, victory is ours. But we can't rest just yet.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t17: Have a look sir, we found these plans in the officer's quarters. They are going to attack our top-secret research facility.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t18: That laboratory needs our help then. Maybe they are working on something interesting.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_desc: Meridian Combine is attacking a secret lab working on new weapons for Ferrovald Syndicate. Make use of previously unseen, powerful units and repel the invaders.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t1: Is anyone there? We are under attack! Please help!
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t2: The laboratory is not lost just yet, but they need reinforcements.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t3: This is Brandt. Do you hear me? What is your situation?
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t4: It is so good to hear you. Meridian Combine surprised us with an attack.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t5: They have taken positions on the other side of the river.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t6: The only bridge, that leads to the other side, is already lost. They are getting closer to the lab.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t7: You must help us, they must not capture this facility and learn about our secret research.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t8: We have a few units here, some of them veterans, that are at your disposal. We are outclassed though. The enemy is using a lot of Helicopters. They are being deployed from these three Airfields.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t9: We can deploy more Tanks and Mobile Infantry units, but they are helpless against flying targets.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t10: Here you can find two of our latest developments: Mobile Rocket Artillery. These units can deal serious damage from afar but need a lot of support. We have re-used Tank hulls to build them, but we had to ditch a lot of armour, so expect them to be squishy. Even then, they move slowly. And remember, that they can not fight directly, and their missiles can't hit targets right next to them.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t11: These missiles can wreck Helicopters but watch out for cooldowns.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t12: I'm sure they will prove very useful. I have brought some Infantry as well, though they fell a bit behind...
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t13: OK men, let's go and save them! Double time!
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t14: Their attacks from the air do not stop. Are you able to provide more missile systems?
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t15: The fabrication facility that we used to make these two prototypes is not yet fit for larger-scale production. We are working on it. You have to keep Meridian Combine away just a little bit longer.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t16: Until that Factory is ready, I can use my special ability to help with fliers as well. Targeting Automaton allows Tanks, that normally can't shoot into the air, to be able to target flying vessels. Other types of units benefit as well, getting 1 bonus attack point instead. I think it might not have any effect on these new fancy rockets though.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t17: In order to use it, I have to cast it on myself, granting bonuses to up to four units standing right next to me.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t18: We have managed to clear most of the floor used for making custom parts and replaced it with a production line for Rocket Artillery. I think we can start it up, Sir.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t19: The test run of the new equipment went well.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t20: Here is one launcher on the house. Make sure not to lose it, these are expensive.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t22: Thank you for your assistance. We will ramp up production of new Artillery units right away.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t23: Sir! We've got a transmission from Foundermaster Ferron. Meridian Combine is closing in on our capital, they are being encircled.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t24: Send those missile systems to Ferronhold as soon as possible. There is a tough battle ahead of us.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_desc: Operative Borel and his troops are pushing hard towards Foundermaster Ferron's positions. It is up to Consigliere Brandt to stop the Meridian Combine commander and put an end to this incursion.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t1: Close your ranks, we cannot let them pass.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t2: We will fight to the last soldier!
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t3: I hope it will not come to that...
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t4: ...although they do happen to have quite an advantage.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t5: Don't worry my Lord, help is here!
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t6: All units move forward! Foundermaster Ferron must not fall!
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t7: I am thankful for your help, but you have to push forward.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t8: That tower is the last thing keeping them from gaining full control of this mountain pass. If they capture it, nothing will stop them from attacking Ferronhold.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t9: There are four more towers that we must claim in order to secure our position.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t11: Meridian Combine already established an HQ. Taking it out would be a good idea.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t12: I would like to see you try, Brandt.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t13: They sent you here, Borel? I thought they would entrust such an important mission to someone more... capable.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t14: Watch your mouth! This is just payback for attacking Aurelian Holdings. You thought you could get away with it?
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t15: That was a misunderstanding. We will make sure that the one responsible will be brought to justice. I tried to reach Chairman Aurelian to explain the situation, but he did not respond.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t16: Why would he? You cannot be trusted!
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t17: I don't think we can convince him, my Lord.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t18: Just focus on your mission. Disrupt Meridian Combine operations where you can, but capturing these towers is our main goal.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t19: You think you defeated me? This is but a flesh wound. I'll be back!
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t20: That's the last of them. Mission accomplished, my Lord.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t21: Splendid. Relocate your forces along this mountain pass and clean up the remaining Meridian Combine units.
en.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t22: I have to go back and deal with this huge misunderstanding. This has gone on for long enough. Oddly, Chairman Aurelian refuses to respond to my letters. He was always a respectable man. Something is not right...

pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_desc: Heiress Marchetti leads a strike team against Aurelian Holdings after they suddenly attacked a Ferrovald Syndicate outpost. No time to waste waiting for Foundermaster Ferron to send orders.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t1: Sir! I'm bearing important frontline report.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t2: What is the situation? Have we taken the outpost?
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t3: We did, Sir! The second battalion caught them by surprise, they seemed unprepared.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t5: Not quite... Aurelian Holdings soldiers put up a real fight, we have lost more units than anticipated. Our scouts have seen Heir Corvin evacuating from the base not long after our initial strike.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t6: Heir Corvin running away with his tail between his legs? Not surprising. It would explain why they fought so ferociously. Are our forces ready for another push?
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t7: I'm afraid not. They have a lot of wounded soldiers and damaged equipment, which slows them down significantly. The second battalion will not be able to assist for a couple of days.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t8: Bah! I'll reprimand their commander once we join forces. You are dismissed.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t10: Without the second battalion this attack might be difficult.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t11: I only have a few units here. It will have to do.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t12: There are some old Infantry barracks here, I could use them.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t13: I have to capture that outpost to secure this mountain passage into Aurelian Holdings lands.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t14: There is a Tank guarding it though. These are very effective against Infantry, I have to be careful. It does not look like they can deploy more of them though. If I take it out, my mission will be much easier.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t15: Luckily, I do have a couple of aces up my sleeve.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t16: That Infantry unit can now use their Heavy Weapon ability, which should make a quick job of that Tank. It does require that unit to get close and has a long cooldown, so I have to be careful. Leveling up other Infantry units is a good idea.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t17: In order to make sure my Infantry units survive combat with that Tank, I can use my active ability - Hardened Armour. When used, it increases the armour of all units standing 2 tiles away from me, or closer. To use it, I have to cast it on myself.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t19: Enemy command has been captured, Sir!
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t21: I see you were not wasting any time, Marchetti.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t22: Lord's lapdog himself showed up. I'm busy, Brandt.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t23: Not anymore. Foundermaster Ferron sent me to bring new orders to you, personally. Aurelian Holdings's attack concerns him, but he wants to get in touch with Chairman Aurelian first, to explain matters. You will take your forces and retreat to Ferrovald Syndicate lands at once.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t24: And let them get away with an attack against us? Just like that?
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t27: Splendid. I'll return to Ferronhold to attend to other matters.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t28: Foundermaster Ferron is getting soft. Our lands are being attacked and all he can do is sit and wait.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m1_t29: Ferrovald Syndicate deserves better. Aurelian Holdings will pay for their boldness, and when I return, other nobles will surely see which one of us would be a better ruler.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_desc: After meeting up with the Second Battalion, Marchetti plans his next move. He needs to secure supply lines before venturing deeper into Aurelian Holdings territory.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_t1: This is taking too long! Where are my troops?
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_t2: They are on their way, Sir, but we are having trouble supplying them with fuel.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_t3: We need a better route then.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_t4: If we could secure this highway, we could bring in more supplies quickly. It's not going to be easy though.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_t5: Aurelian Holdings has guarded Barracks right in our path.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_t6: Another Barracks and an industrial Factory on the other side of town have to be taken care of as well.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_t7: We are going to need some Tanks then.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_t8: Second Battalion veterans are at your command. They can use Long-range Shell ability, allowing them to hit targets up to one tile away in a straight line. They can take out an enemy Tank before it is able to retaliate.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_t9: We have almost finished setting up our own Tank factory. All it needs is a crew.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_t10: Marvelous. My passive ability allows me to build Tanks using less AP than usual. That should give me an edge over Aurelian Holdings.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_t11: Mission complete, Sir! With this route secured, we will be able to advance much faster.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m2_t12: Get moving then. We are already late with the next phase.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m3_desc: Faced with ever-increasing amounts of Aurelian Holdings armored vehicles, the first Battalion under Marchetti's command needs to establish air superiority.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m3_t1: What does the road ahead look like?
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m3_t2: Aurelian Holdings has a lot of Factories here, Sir.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m3_t3: There is one nearby, with some tanks ready to go.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m3_t4: Their main forces are stationed in a nearby town.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m3_t5: They have several Towers in the area for support, so we should expect a lot of Tanks to be produced.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m3_t6: We need to hasten our work on the Airfield then.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m3_t7: It is still being worked on, it will take some time for it to provide air support.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m3_t8: These veteran units will help in stopping Aurelian Holdings for now, but we can't hold this position for long.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m3_o1: Defend until your Airfield becomes available.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m3_t10: Air support is ready to go. Those Tanks are going to be helpless against them!
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m3_t11: Town guards have been defeated. With an Airfield in this area, Ferrovald Syndicate can bring in all the units that we need to beat Aurelian Holdings once and for all.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_desc: Assembled forces of Ferrovald Syndicate face one last obstacle on their way to Aurelian Bastion: the Aurelian River.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t1: We've got the upper hand in this fight now.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t2: Our base is nearly done, Sir. A couple of buildings still need a crew.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t3: What is the situation at the river crossing?
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t4: Take a look at this intel, Sir.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t5: The bridge is heavily guarded by armour and infantry.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t6: It is supplied by a small checkpoint nearby.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t7: The other side is guarded as well.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t8: A much larger installation is present there as well.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t9: That HQ building must be coordinating all of their forces. Taking it is our main objective.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t11: On its way, should be here very soon.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t12: Good. Start building up our army in the meantime, then attack that checkpoint.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t13: Air support is in the area. Waiting for orders.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t14: A veteran Attack Helicopter will be very useful.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t15: Our tower has been monitoring this flank.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t16: It appears there are no enemy units on this side. The way to the enemy HQ is wide open.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t17: The only problem is the river. It is very wide and deep. This is where that helicopter comes in.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t18: An Attack Helicopter is capable of carrying a single Infantry unit on board. If we can ferry a few units, we can perform a back attack.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t19: Make sure that they have cover, as these Infantry units will not be able to do anything until their next turn, right after deployment.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t20: We can also use our helicopters to perform flanking attacks on enemy units trying to hold or cross the bridge. Any Tank will be a sitting duck.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_o1: (Optional) Transport Infantry units for the back attack.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m4_t21: Without their command center, enemy forces will disperse. Let's secure this base and start bringing our Tanks over the bridge for the final assault.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_desc: Ferrovald Syndicate is pushing forward with their offensive. Marchetti prepares to capture a strategic position, that will allow him to lay a siege on the Aurelian Holdings capital city of Aurelian Bastion.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t1: I need to get to the Aurelian Bastion to see my father right now!
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t2: I'm sorry my heir, but getting into the city might be very difficult. Ferrovald Syndicate is approaching fast.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t3: No one has seen Chairman Aurelian since the invasion started. Commander Vex is relaying orders from him.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t4: My father hiding? He would never do such a thing!
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t5: Ferrovald Syndicate's main army was spotted!
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t6: To arms! We have to stop them!
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t8: Aurelian Holdings's capital city is in our sight.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t9: That base is in a perfect spot, if we take it, we can easily occupy the city from there.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t10: We have some trouble, Sir. Our forward outposts have been spotted early.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t11: Infantry barracks are here. This should be our top priority, Aurelian Holdings can use them to attack our flank.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t12: Factory here has no crew but is guarded by a Tank, we should be careful.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t13: We managed to deploy an Airfield further out, with some Towers for support.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t14: Failure is not an option at this point. I can already smell victory.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t15: Position taken. Start preparing troop transports to cross the water.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t16: Hahaha, that was easier than I expected. Aurelian Bastion will be ours soon, and then we will see what can be done about Foundermaster Ferron...
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t18: Brandt? What are you doing here?
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t19: You have disobeyed the Lord's orders. Your offensive ends here. Men, arrest him.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t20: Don't you dare to lay your hands on me!
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t21: I will deliver you to Ferronhold personally.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t22: Argh! This is no good! I can't keep it up.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t23: I must find my father immediately.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m5_t24: Haha! The cowardly heir flees yet again.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_desc: Brandt's task is simple: bring Heiress Marchetti back to Ferronhold. Or so it seemed, as a new and unexpected force is standing in his way, cutting him off.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t1: Marchetti made such a mess! It's unbelievable! And now I will have to endure his company all the way to Ferronhold. *sigh*
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t2: It can't be helped. Soldier! Go tell the guards to bring him in and we will depart.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t3: Sir! Sir! I have important news!
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t4: What is it? Catch your breath and tell me.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t5: It's Meridian Combine! They are everywhere! Have a look!
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t6: They are already setting up blockades.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t7: But that is not all! We've got an emergency transmission from Foundermaster Ferron. Meridian Combine is already assaulting our border. You are being ordered to return as quickly as possible and organize defense.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t8: What are we waiting for then? Organize Marchetti's forces and go home!
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t9: I don't think we can, Sir.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t10: Meridian Combine gathered huge forces on the other side of the river. They are ready to strike on our positions. If we try to move now, they will surely take advantage and wipe us out.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t11: This is really bad. Looks like our best chance is to sneak past them with a small detachment. Heiress Marchetti will have to stay here for a little longer...
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t12: My goal is to reach that road. Looks like Meridian Combine is using some of the Aurelian Holdings towers to supply themselves.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t13: We have barracks and a single tower here. Our resources are going to be really stretched, but it will have to do.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t14: My passive ability allows me to get an additional 5AP from every tower, each turn. It is not much, but it stacks up.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t16: You have nowhere to run. Surrender now!
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t17: I'm afraid that is out of the question. We have to deal with that Tank somehow. I can deal significant damage to it, but constant fighting might wear me down, so I have to be careful.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t18: I have to move, there is no time to lose.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_o1: Bring Consigliere Brandt to the end of the road.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t19: Mobile Infantry is ready to support you, Sir.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t20: This is exactly what I needed. These motorized units are much faster than regular Infantry. They are ideal for quick capture jobs. Their weaponry is not as good, so they can't attack flying targets, though it seems it will not be an issue at this time.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t21: We also have some experience, Sir, so we can use our abilities to heal soldiers and even repair vehicles. It costs AP though. We will do what we can to keep you in this fight!
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t22: I can recruit more Mobile Infantry units in the barracks if need be.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t23: What is Meridian Combine doing here? And attacking our lands as well? Has Aurelian Holdings asked them for help? Or are they just using an opportunity?
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t24: No matter. I am needed at our border.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m6_t25: I have failed you, my lord! Please forgive me!
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_desc: Ferrovald Syndicate lands are under attack. Consigliere Brandt must secure the base in Tripoint and stop Meridian Combine before it is too late.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t1: Oh no, our base is already lost. And now they are using our equipment.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t2: I need these facilities if I am to stop them from sending in more troops toward Ferronhold. HQ building is my top priority - if I capture it, I can re-take control of the entire base.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t3: They have a sizable garrison, I need to be careful.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t4: Good thing I've got two Scout Helicopters at my disposal. They have less firepower than the Attack variety, but they are faster.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t5: Do we have any intel on the area?
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t6: Mobile Brigade garrison is nearby, but it has been captured. If we claim it, we will have access to more Mobile Infantry units, as our current Barracks can't deploy them.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t8: It does not appear to be operational. We have deployed a paratrooper unit there, but...
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t9: Meridian Combine sent a Tank on patrol, and it is very close. Unless we do something, that Infantry unit is lost.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t10: I'm an experienced pilot, and I know this nimble machine very well. I can use my active ability to fully replenish my MP, and even perform another attack on the same turn. I do need 1MP to activate it though, so make sure to not order me to use it all up if you intend me to use Rapid Response.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t11: I should be able to get there in time and keep Tanks at bay until our boys capture the building.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t12: Do what you can, we need those flying units.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t13: Thank you for the air support, we couldn't have done this without you!
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t15: Sorry for the delay, Sir. We took the long route. Ready to support the southern flank.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t16: Great work men, victory is ours. But we can't rest just yet.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t17: Have a look sir, we found these plans in the officer's quarters. They are going to attack our top-secret research facility.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m7_t18: That laboratory needs our help then. Maybe they are working on something interesting.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_desc: Meridian Combine is attacking a secret lab working on new weapons for Ferrovald Syndicate. Make use of previously unseen, powerful units and repel the invaders.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t1: Is anyone there? We are under attack! Please help!
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t2: The laboratory is not lost just yet, but they need reinforcements.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t3: This is Brandt. Do you hear me? What is your situation?
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t4: It is so good to hear you. Meridian Combine surprised us with an attack.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t5: They have taken positions on the other side of the river.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t6: The only bridge, that leads to the other side, is already lost. They are getting closer to the lab.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t7: You must help us, they must not capture this facility and learn about our secret research.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t8: We have a few units here, some of them veterans, that are at your disposal. We are outclassed though. The enemy is using a lot of Helicopters. They are being deployed from these three Airfields.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t9: We can deploy more Tanks and Mobile Infantry units, but they are helpless against flying targets.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t10: Here you can find two of our latest developments: Mobile Rocket Artillery. These units can deal serious damage from afar but need a lot of support. We have re-used Tank hulls to build them, but we had to ditch a lot of armour, so expect them to be squishy. Even then, they move slowly. And remember, that they can not fight directly, and their missiles can't hit targets right next to them.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t11: These missiles can wreck Helicopters but watch out for cooldowns.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t12: I'm sure they will prove very useful. I have brought some Infantry as well, though they fell a bit behind...
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t13: OK men, let's go and save them! Double time!
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t14: Their attacks from the air do not stop. Are you able to provide more missile systems?
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t15: The fabrication facility that we used to make these two prototypes is not yet fit for larger-scale production. We are working on it. You have to keep Meridian Combine away just a little bit longer.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t16: Until that Factory is ready, I can use my special ability to help with fliers as well. Targeting Automaton allows Tanks, that normally can't shoot into the air, to be able to target flying vessels. Other types of units benefit as well, getting 1 bonus attack point instead. I think it might not have any effect on these new fancy rockets though.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t17: In order to use it, I have to cast it on myself, granting bonuses to up to four units standing right next to me.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t18: We have managed to clear most of the floor used for making custom parts and replaced it with a production line for Rocket Artillery. I think we can start it up, Sir.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t19: The test run of the new equipment went well.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t20: Here is one launcher on the house. Make sure not to lose it, these are expensive.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t22: Thank you for your assistance. We will ramp up production of new Artillery units right away.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t23: Sir! We've got a transmission from Foundermaster Ferron. Meridian Combine is closing in on our capital, they are being encircled.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m8_t24: Send those missile systems to Ferronhold as soon as possible. There is a tough battle ahead of us.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_desc: Operative Borel and his troops are pushing hard towards Foundermaster Ferron's positions. It is up to Consigliere Brandt to stop the Meridian Combine commander and put an end to this incursion.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t1: Close your ranks, we cannot let them pass.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t2: We will fight to the last soldier!
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t3: I hope it will not come to that...
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t4: ...although they do happen to have quite an advantage.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t5: Don't worry my Lord, help is here!
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t6: All units move forward! Foundermaster Ferron must not fall!
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t7: I am thankful for your help, but you have to push forward.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t8: That tower is the last thing keeping them from gaining full control of this mountain pass. If they capture it, nothing will stop them from attacking Ferronhold.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t9: There are four more towers that we must claim in order to secure our position.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t11: Meridian Combine already established an HQ. Taking it out would be a good idea.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t12: I would like to see you try, Brandt.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t13: They sent you here, Borel? I thought they would entrust such an important mission to someone more... capable.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t14: Watch your mouth! This is just payback for attacking Aurelian Holdings. You thought you could get away with it?
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t15: That was a misunderstanding. We will make sure that the one responsible will be brought to justice. I tried to reach Chairman Aurelian to explain the situation, but he did not respond.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t16: Why would he? You cannot be trusted!
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t17: I don't think we can convince him, my Lord.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t18: Just focus on your mission. Disrupt Meridian Combine operations where you can, but capturing these towers is our main goal.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t19: You think you defeated me? This is but a flesh wound. I'll be back!
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t20: That's the last of them. Mission accomplished, my Lord.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t21: Splendid. Relocate your forces along this mountain pass and clean up the remaining Meridian Combine units.
pl.tr_core_ruby_dusk_m9_t22: I have to go back and deal with this huge misunderstanding. This has gone on for long enough. Oddly, Chairman Aurelian refuses to respond to my letters. He was always a respectable man. Something is not right...
